card.name: Large number scale before a counted noun
card.fires_on: The scale word or last zero in a large figure (million, lakh, 000) right before the thing being counted, such as people, barrels, doses or acre-feet. Also 'housing' just before 'units'.

modes.label: Scale word after a number
modes.description: The word million or lakh follows a figure and the counted noun comes next.
modes.example: with more than 200<< million>> people abusing drugs worldwide

modes.label: Final zero of a big figure
modes.description: The last 0 of a number written with zeros, followed by a unit of measure.

modes.label: Housing before units
modes.description: The word housing in the phrase number of housing units.
modes.example: require more land to develop the same number of<< housing>> units

card.writes: It promotes words for million, ten-thousand, units and beds, so it pushes toward a counted quantity word or unit noun next.
card.plain: It fires when a very large number is being written out and the thing counted is about to be named.
evidence: with more than 200<< million>> people abusing drugs worldwide
the Centre has procured nearly 15<< lakh>> doses of swine flu vaccine
